entities.summary: Jacious Sears is an American track and field athlete who competes as a sprinter. She is the reigning American champion over 60 metres having won the title at the 2026 USA Indoor Championships and was the silver medalist in the 60 metres at the 2026 World Indoor Championships. Sears was a gold medalist in the women's 4 x 100 metres relay at the 2025 World Championships.
